# bdk settings - every key of .bdk/settings.yaml

::: v-pre

Keys are written in YAML in `.bdk/settings.yaml` (shared with the team), `.bdk/settings.local.yaml` (yours, not committed) or `~/.config/bdk/settings.yaml` (all your projects; `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/bdk/settings.yaml` when that variable is set). `<id>` stands for the `id` of an item; `<role>` and `<orchestrator>` for a name you choose.

Each section shows itself whole: an example with every key of the section, what the key is for, and its default where the example changes it. A settings file needs only the keys you change.

## `tools` {#tools}

Type: mapping of the keys below

The project's commands, which `/bdk:setup` detects.

```yaml
tools:
  # Commands that run the project's tests
  test:
    - # Names the command
      id: vitest
      # Shell command run from the project root
      command: pnpm test
      # Variant of the command for a set of files
      scoped: pnpm vitest run {files}
  # Commands that lint the project
  lint:
    - id: eslint
      command: pnpm lint
      scoped: pnpm eslint {files}
  # Commands that build the project
  build:
    - id: vite
      command: pnpm build
  # How to start the product so the E2E tester can use it as a user would
  e2e:
    - # Names the entry
      id: web
      # Command that starts the product for the E2E tester
      start: pnpm dev
      # URL that answers, or command that exits 0, once the started product is ready
      ready: http://localhost:5173
      # How the E2E tester uses the product: as a command line, over HTTP, or in a browser (cli | http | browser)
      driver: browser
```

### `tools.test` {#tools-test}

Type: list of items, each with an `id`; layers merge items by `id` · Default: `[]`

Commands that run the project's tests; `bdk check run` runs them, each by its `id`.

| Key | Type | Required or default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>.id` | string | Required | Names the command; other layers and `bdk config set` address it by this id. |
| `<id>.command` | string | Required | Shell command run from the project root. |
| `<id>.scoped` | string |  | Variant of the command for a set of files; `{files}` is replaced by the changed files, so a check covers only what a part touched. |
| `<id>.timeout` | integer, 1 to 86400 |  | Seconds before `bdk check run` stops the command; 600 when absent. |
| `<id>.paths` | list of strings |  | Globs of the files the command checks, matched like rule paths. On a scoped run the command gets only the changed files they match, and is skipped when none matches; every file when absent. |

### `tools.e2e` {#tools-e2e}

Type: list of items, each with an `id`; layers merge items by `id` · Default: `[]`

How to start the product so the E2E tester can use it as a user would.

| Key | Type | Required or default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>.id` | string | Required | Names the entry; other layers and `bdk config set` address it by this id. |
| `<id>.start` | string | Required | Command that starts the product for the E2E tester. |
| `<id>.ready` | string | Required | URL that answers, or command that exits 0, once the started product is ready. |
| `<id>.driver` | one of `cli`, `http`, `browser` | Required | How the E2E tester uses the product: as a command line, over HTTP, or in a browser. |
| `<id>.env` | mapping of names to values |  | Environment variables set for `start`. |
| `<id>.env.<name>` | string | Required | Value of the environment variable. |
| `<id>.browser` | one of `playwright`, `chrome-devtools-mcp` |  | Browser tool the E2E tester drives; read only for `driver: browser`, where an absent value means `playwright`. |

## `languages` {#languages}

Type: list of strings · Default: `[]`

Languages of the project; `bdk rules for` picks the rule pack's language rules by them.

```yaml
languages:
  - typescript
  - react
```

## `rules` {#rules}

Type: mapping of the keys below

Which rules of the BDK rule pack and of `.bdk/rules/` apply.

```yaml
rules:
  # Rules of the rule pack that no role reads in this project
  disabled:
    - BDK-DP-2
    - BDK-REACT-10
```

### `rules.disabled` {#rules-disabled}

Type: list of strings · Default: `[]`

Rules of the rule pack that no role reads in this project.

## `models` {#models}

Type: mapping of names to values · Default: `{}`

Model and effort per agent role, each role named after its agent: `lead`, `explorer`, `verifier`, `implementer`, `conformer`, `reviewer`, `integration-reviewer`, `e2e-tester`, `judge`, `designer` or `planner`; a field not set leaves the agent on its default model and the session's effort.

| Key | Type | Required or default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<role>` | mapping of the keys below | Required | Model and effort the agent of this role runs with. |
| `<role>.model` | string |  | Model name or alias the agent of this role runs on; its default when absent. |
| `<role>.effort` | one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` |  | Reasoning effort of the agent of this role; the session's when absent. |

```yaml
models:
  # Model and effort the agent of this role runs with
  implementer:
    # Model name or alias the agent of this role runs on
    model: opus
    # Reasoning effort of the agent of this role (low | medium | high | xhigh | max)
    effort: high
  reviewer:
    model: sonnet
  planner:
    effort: xhigh
```

## `policy` {#policy}

Type: mapping of the keys below

How autonomous a run is: gates, questions, budgets and escalation.

```yaml
policy:
  # Where a run stops for your decision
  gates:
    # `manual`: you approve a verified design before `/bdk:plan`, and a bug diagnosis before `/bdk:debug` builds the fix (manual | auto, default: manual)
    design: auto
    # `manual`: you decide fix, accept or defer for each finding of a review round (manual | auto, default: manual)
    review: auto
  # What a skill does with an open question: `stop` asks you (decide-and-record | stop, default: stop)
  questions: decide-and-record
  # Limits on retries, so a run ends
  budgets:
    # Most implementer runs one plan part gets in one `/bdk:execute` run before it counts as blocked (default: 3)
    part-attempts: 4
    # Most review rounds one `/bdk:auto-review` run takes (default: 3)
    review-rounds: 2
    # Most verifier passes one design or plan orchestrator run spends
    verifier: 3
  # What a run does before it gives up on a part
  escalation:
    # Model the last implementer run of a plan part runs on, within its `policy.budgets.part-attempts`
    model: opus
```

### `policy.gates` {#policy-gates}

Type: mapping of the keys below

Where a run stops for your decision.

### `policy.gates.design` {#policy-gates-design}

Type: one of `manual`, `auto` · Default: `"manual"`

`manual`: you approve a verified design before `/bdk:plan`, and a bug diagnosis before `/bdk:debug` builds the fix; `auto`: both are approved without asking.

### `policy.gates.review` {#policy-gates-review}

Type: one of `manual`, `auto` · Default: `"manual"`

`manual`: you decide fix, accept or defer for each finding of a review round; `auto`: triage decides by each finding's level.

### `policy.questions` {#policy-questions}

Type: one of `decide-and-record`, `stop` · Default: `"stop"`

What a skill does with an open question: `stop` asks you; `decide-and-record` takes the recommended answer and records it.

### `policy.budgets` {#policy-budgets}

Type: mapping of the keys below

Limits on retries, so a run ends.

### `policy.budgets.part-attempts` {#policy-budgets-part-attempts}

Type: integer, at least 1 · Default: `3`

Most implementer runs one plan part gets in one `/bdk:execute` run before it counts as blocked.

### `policy.budgets.review-rounds` {#policy-budgets-review-rounds}

Type: integer, at least 1 · Default: `3`

Most review rounds one `/bdk:auto-review` run takes.

### `policy.budgets.verifier` {#policy-budgets-verifier}

Type: integer, at least 1 · Default: `3`

Most verifier passes one design or plan orchestrator run spends.

### `policy.escalation` {#policy-escalation}

Type: mapping of the keys below

What a run does before it gives up on a part.

### `policy.escalation.model` {#policy-escalation-model}

Type: string · Default: `"opus"`

Model the last implementer run of a plan part runs on, within its `policy.budgets.part-attempts`.

### `policy.escalation.effort` {#policy-escalation-effort}

Type: one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`

Effort of the last implementer run of a plan part; when absent that run takes `models.implementer.effort`.

## `plan` {#plan}

Type: mapping of the keys below

Rules for the plans `/bdk:plan` writes.

```yaml
plan:
  # Size limits of one plan part, so one agent can finish it
  part:
    # Most tasks in one plan part (default: 5)
    max-tasks: 4
    # Most files one plan part may touch (default: 10)
    max-files: 8
    # Most bytes of one plan part file
    max-bytes: 8192
```

### `plan.part` {#plan-part}

Type: mapping of the keys below

Size limits of one plan part, so one agent can finish it.

### `plan.part.max-tasks` {#plan-part-max-tasks}

Type: integer, at least 1 · Default: `5`

Most tasks in one plan part; `bdk plan check` reports a larger part.

### `plan.part.max-files` {#plan-part-max-files}

Type: integer, at least 1 · Default: `10`

Most files one plan part may touch; `bdk plan check` reports a larger part.

### `plan.part.max-bytes` {#plan-part-max-bytes}

Type: integer, at least 1 · Default: `8192`

Most bytes of one plan part file; `bdk plan check` reports a larger part.

## `steps` {#steps}

Type: mapping of names to values · Default: `{}`

Not read by any orchestrator yet: per-orchestrator step changes the configuration accepts.

| Key | Type | Required or default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<orchestrator>` | list of items, each with an `id`; layers merge items by `id` | Required | Changes to the steps of this orchestrator, each by the step's `id`. |
| `<orchestrator>.<id>.id` | string | Required | The step of the orchestrator this entry changes. |
| `<orchestrator>.<id>.enabled` | boolean |  | `false` skips the step. |
| `<orchestrator>.<id>.use` | string |  | Project skill or agent that runs instead of the step's block. |

```yaml
steps:
  # Changes to the steps of this orchestrator, each by the step's `id`
  auto-review:
    - # The step of the orchestrator this entry changes
      id: e2e
      # `false` skips the step
      enabled: false
```

## `execution` {#execution}

Type: mapping of the keys below

How the lead agents run.

```yaml
execution:
  # Whether the lead agent of `/bdk:execute`, `/bdk:auto-review` and `/bdk:pr-review` runs in the background or in your session (background | foreground, default: background)
  lead: foreground
  # Most part agents the execute lead runs at once (default: 10)
  max-parallel: 4
```

### `execution.lead` {#execution-lead}

Type: one of `background`, `foreground` · Default: `"background"`

Whether the lead agent of `/bdk:execute`, `/bdk:auto-review` and `/bdk:pr-review` runs in the background or in your session.

### `execution.max-parallel` {#execution-max-parallel}

Type: integer, at least 1 · Default: `10`

Most part agents the execute lead runs at once.

## `hooks` {#hooks}

Type: mapping of the keys below

Hooks of the bdk plugin.

```yaml
hooks:
  # `true` makes the `PreToolUse` guard deny git commands that change history in every subagent except the lead (default: false)
  subagent-git: true
```

### `hooks.subagent-git` {#hooks-subagent-git}

Type: boolean · Default: `false`

`true` makes the `PreToolUse` guard deny git commands that change history in every subagent except the lead.

:::
